sin.name: sql-outside-database-layer
sin.description: A string of SQL outside src/journal/db: a repository or a feature writes its own query text, so the column names go unchecked and the shapes of the queries spread across the code.
sin.rule: Compose the read or the write with Query in a repository: self.query().filter(state=...).order_descending("id").limit(n), handed to selected, counted, maximum or purged. SQL text is rendered only by the builder in src/journal/db and run only by the Connection; a shape the builder lacks is added to Query.
